capabilities.name: Yahoo

connect.label: Connect with Yahoo
connect.where: Connect with Yahoo: Yahoo asks you to allow read-only access to your fantasy leagues, then your leagues are listed here to pick from. A league's link (the number after /f1/) works too once you are connected.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: Yahoo's stat modifiers read into the projections' scoring; any stat not priced is listed on the league card — as built, not verified on a live league yet

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: Yahoo's positions read as ours (W/R/T as FLEX, Q/W/R/T as superflex); IDP slots are left out and said so — as built, not verified on a live league yet

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: each week's opponent and points from Yahoo's scoreboard — as built, not verified on a live league yet

players.label: Players
players.words: Yahoo ids matched to Sleeper's through nflverse's id table; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued — as built, not verified on a live league yet

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents from Yahoo's player list; waiver priority and budgets are not read — as built, not verified on a live league yet

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades from Yahoo's transactions — as built, not verified on a live league yet

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: DEF as team defenses; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read — as built, not verified on a live league yet

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform, for the players matched to our ids — as built, not verified on a live league yet

capabilities.note: Through Yahoo's official Fantasy Sports API, read-only, after you allow it with your Yahoo sign-in.

note: Connect with Yahoo to list your leagues here.
